reason: The schema accepts an event, trip or vehicle if it matches exactly one of four modes (car share, delivery robots, micromobility, passenger services). A valid scooter record can match more than one, which fails it. This city regulates micromobility only, so the micromobility rules are applied directly.

The rule 'trip events must carry a trip id' is written with a list under `contains`, which is not valid JSON Schema and never takes effect. Rewritten so it does what the MDS text says (modes/micromobility.md, Trip ID Requirements).
MDS 2.1 adds the vehicle types scooter, van and freight (data-types.md).
MDS 2.1 adds the parking categories space and dock (data-types.md, Trips).
